design.name: 燎 (red panda fire gunslinger)
design.role: 火系输出：燃爆雷 / 九尾狐火→爆竹火团 / 余烬
design.brief: An agile anthropomorphic RED PANDA gunslinger and firework grenadier. Round head with small rounded ears with white rims, white cheek and eyebrow markings and tear-stripes, bright amber eyes, a cheeky grin. Rust-red fur on head and back, black legs and arms, a huge bushy tail with bold cream and rust rings. Wears a short dark-charcoal Song-dynasty martial jacket with a high collar and ember-orange lining, the right sleeve rolled up, a cinnabar sash, wrapped black trousers and sturdy short boots. A diagonal bandolier of red Chinese firecracker grenades (爆竹手雷) with gold paper caps across the chest, a small brass fire-starter lantern (火折子) on the hip glowing with orange-gold spirit fire. Hands with a clearly separate thumb and four separate fingers.
design.weapon: a chunky stylized lever rifle with brass fittings held in one hand while the other hand flicks a lit firecracker grenade, three small orange spirit-fire wisps circling the tail
design.turnaround_lead: Neutral standing A-pose for rigging: arms held about 40 degrees away from the body with straight elbows, both hands open, flat and EMPTY (no gun, no grenade, no weapons anywhere), legs straight and slightly apart, mouth closed, calm expression
design.turnaround_pose: , the firecracker bandolier and the small brass lantern on the hip worn as on the sheet (lantern glowing softly, no flames or wisps outside it), the big ringed tail extending straight backwards and slightly down behind the body, fully shown in the side views
design.turnaround_digits: each hand open with a separate thumb and four separate slightly spread fingers (fingerless gloves), both boots complete.
